name: ParaSwap Augustus V5 simpleSwap arbitrary-callee approval drain
summary: AugustusSwapper.simpleSwap() executes caller-supplied callee/exchangeData sequences as the router itself, so an attacker who flash-borrowed 1000 wei of WETH as the nominal fromToken could have the router run DAI.move against an account that still held a ParaSwap authorisation and forward the proceeds to an attacker-chosen beneficiary.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

sources.note: onchain review: AugustusSwapper V5 0xdef171fe48cf0115b1d80b88dc8eab59176fee57 created 2021-08-18T12:42:05Z by 0xf01121e808f782d7f34e857c27da31ad1f151b39, not the attack-tx sender 0x2d9a39de3e5227ff74b4cfc154b16fd77614ee33; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the Augustus address itself, 1406.6 days old. Same arbitrary-callee family as the recorded Augustus V6 row but a different deployment and a different transaction. 2,299.04 DAI drained from 0x1e0c22a1f39b6c7f36661297437e874ec31fa0b1, taken at 1:1 as a USD-pegged stable.

delegatecall-target review (callTracer + prestateTracer on the exploit tx, then eth_getStorageAt over [creation block, incident block]): AugustusSwapper V5 is a per-selector route table, not a single-implementation proxy. The exploit tx makes exactly one DELEGATECALL, 0xdef171fe...ee57 -> 0x66c1c25d7d2bd4a32ed33501e202b275030f402c with selector 0x54e3f31b (simpleSwap), and prestateTracer shows that address read from mapping slot 0xd0d6677800a993d9f57d5429a1a7401f674e568d0f74ca8057f1e2e320362e92. Binary-searching that slot between the creation block 13049291 and the incident block 22778355 gives seven writes: 0x7a5a0be8 (2021-08-18T13:30:43Z), 0xba7fe1aa (2021-08-18T13:59:08Z), cleared to zero (2022-01-06), 0x2938bc86 (2022-01-10), 0xa655d026 (2022-02-24), 0x6e8b66cc (2022-06-15) and 0x66c1c25d7d2bd4a32ed33501e202b275030f402c at block 17472047, 2023-06-13T15:45:23Z, constant across 60 samples up to the incident. The exploited simpleSwap code was therefore 742.4 days old, not the 1406.6 days measured from the Augustus deployment
